meta.name: rundown
meta.description: Answer in the Rundown briefing style (TL;DR + checklist + numbered choices).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 输出简报式回答,包含摘要、清单和选项
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你希望每次回答都抓重点、给清单、列选项。
copy.tagline_en: Output responses as briefing summaries with checklist and options.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want every answer to highlight key points, list checks, and show choices.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 回复会改成简报式:先给一行 TL;DR 总述,再用 ✅/🟡/⬜ 等清单逐项标状态,最后用编号列表给出下一步;被要求写正式内容时,它只输出内容本身。
howto.when: 你选用 rundown 技能,或明确说“用 rundown 风格回答”后,Claude 从下一条回复起持续按此风格输出。

say.text: 用 rundown 风格总结这次会议。
say.note: Claude 会给出 TL;DR 与要点清单。

say.text: 按 rundown 格式列出当前风险和待定事项。
say.note: 它会把阻塞项单独用 🔴 标出。

say.text: 请用 rundown 简报格式写项目状态更新。
say.note: 写正文时,它只交付更新本身。

howto.what_en: After this skill is active, Claude's answers shift to a briefing layout: an opening TL;DR, state-bearing checklists, and a numbered "Your move" list. When asked for an actual message, it gives just that deliverable.
howto.when_en: Active once you pick the rundown skill or tell Claude to "answer in rundown style"; the format persists from the next reply onward.

say_en.text: Use the rundown style to summarize today's meeting.
say_en.note: You get a TL;DR and a checklist of key points.

say_en.text: List current risks and open items in rundown format.
Write the weekly project update as a rundown briefing.
say_en.note: For writing tasks it delivers only the piece itself.
